courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 明挖覆蓋隧道施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「凝結與地下水來源」與「排水保留與壓力轉移」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；明挖覆蓋隧道施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Condensation and groundwater sources" and "Drainage preservation and pressure transfer" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Cut-and-cover tunnel construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以水源診斷、活動裂縫與修補相容性處理既有隧道漏水；明挖覆蓋隧道施工則以整合明挖隧道的地表界面、支撐、水壓與回填階段為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on repair existing-tunnel leakage through source diagnosis, active-crack assessment and material compatibility; Cut-and-cover tunnel construction centres on integrate surface interfaces, bracing, water pressure and backfilling in cut-and-cover tunnels, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「凝結與地下水來源」與「開挖尺度與地表影響」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到明挖覆蓋隧道施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Condensation and groundwater sources” and “Excavation scale and surface impact”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cut-and-cover tunnel construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Brace removal and load transfer", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on repair existing-tunnel leakage through source diagnosis, active-crack assessment and material compatibility; Top-down underground construction centres on track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「凝結與地下水來源」與「永久樓板的早期支撐」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Condensation and groundwater sources” and “Permanent slabs as early braces”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Top-down underground construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 既有隧道漏水修繕
history.text: 本課討論的以水源診斷、活動裂縫與修補相容性處理既有隧道漏水，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on repair existing-tunnel leakage through source diagnosis, active-crack assessment and material compatibility reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「凝結與地下水來源」到「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Condensation and groundwater sources" through "Repair history and recurrent defects" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
